description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}.
Mimic Vat triggers, exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Wolf, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
